issue.description:
Plan: docs/plan/plan.md Phase 4. Blocked by Phase 5 (event-grain events) and by the cross-repo gate for
upstream attribution.

## Task
- Add a fourth scope level `worker` computed from `bead_events.actor` for events after the attribution
  epoch (first `closed` event with a non-`system` actor per repo); earlier events are labelled
  `inferential` and excluded from worker counts by default.
- Panel (`public/git-activity/` in dashboard-site is out of scope here; this bead ships the data and
  `meta.json` epoch marker only).

## Acceptance
- `hourly.parquet` gains `worker` rows only for post-epoch events; `meta.json` carries
  `attribution_epoch` per repo; tests cover pre/post epoch.
issue.title: Worker-tier scope from attributed bead-event actors (Phase 4)

issue.description:
Plan: docs/plan/plan.md Phase 5 (Factory ledger join). Independent; the actor column will read
`system` for closes until upstream attribution ships, and that is fine: schema first.

## Task
- src/beads.py / src/aggregate.py: ensure `bead_events.parquet` has one row per forensic event with
  `repo`, `workspace_uuid` (origin_store_uuid), `issue_id`, `kind`, `actor`, `time`, `resulting_status`;
  keep the existing rollup unchanged.
- docs/notes/output-schema.md: a "Join keys" section describing how the factory attempt ledger joins
  on (`issue_id`, `actor`, time window) and how `runs.parquet` joins on commit; note the attribution
  epoch caveat.
- Tests for the event-grain writer with a forensic fixture.

## Acceptance
- Parquet schema documented and stable; existing panel unaffected (hourly.parquet unchanged).
- Fixture with 5 events round-trips with all columns.
issue.title: Publish bead events at event grain with actor and workspace identity; document ledger join keys (Phase 5)

issue.description:
This bead is a **cross-repo gate**. It stands in for work that lives in another repository and
must ship before the beads it blocks can start. Upstream: bead-rs beadrs-e167fde8, NEEDLE needle-c81694f1.

Do not implement the upstream change here, and do not close this bead from this repository.
It is closed by the operator (or by the upstream's release step) once the upstream bead is closed
and its release is installed where this repo's consumers run. Its assignee is set to `operator`
precisely so that the ready frontier never offers it to a worker.
issue.title: Cross-repo gate: bead-rs BR-T12 (beadrs-e167fde8) and NEEDLE N-T17 (needle-c81694f1) make closes attributable
